economic_rule.selfish: higher realized aggregator revenue is better
economic_rule.altruistic: first require the 50% baseline-revenue retention floor, then lower realized full-day PTO cost is better

secondary_outcome_rule.cheap_price_zone: spot price in the lower third of the realized daily min-max range
secondary_outcome_rule.expensive_price_zone: spot price in the upper third of the realized daily min-max range
secondary_outcome_rule.downward_flexibility: realized charging energy in cheap-price intervals
secondary_outcome_rule.upward_flexibility: realized V2G export energy in expensive-price intervals

uncertainty.method: nonparametric bootstrap over repeated runs within each case-mode cell
